blocks.x: If you ask me, one of the best parts about travel is sightseeing. Nothing beats taking in the skyline views, gorgeous green spaces, and exciting landmarks that make each city unique. But it’s no secret that travel can be expensive—between lodging, transportation, and activities, even a few days of vacation can add up.

To make the most of your trip (and your budget), consider using CityPass to find discounted tickets to all the coolest attractions around the US at the best prices. Whether you’re headed to the top of the Empire State Building in NYC, taking a tour of Universal Studios Hollywood in LA, or enjoying the views from the Space Needle in Seattle, you can find excellent deals on some of the best attractions around the country. Available in 17 different locations around the US, here’s how to take advantage of the platform and enjoy your trip to the fullest.
Take up to 51% off top attractions around the country with CityPass—no coupons required
CityPass lists attractions at a discounted rate of up to 51% off, so you can take your sightseeing to the next level without breaking the bank.

The ticketing agency also offers ticket bundles in top destinations like Boston and Dallas, offering a discount of up to 50% on tickets by purchasing a few different attractions at the same time with no need for coupons.

There’s no CityPass promo code needed to reap these rewards since they’re already integrated into the overall price. Another pro: You’ll not only save money, but also time, since most passes let you skip the ticket lines. To redeem your tickets, simply purchase through the website—most deals are applied automatically. From there, you’ll likely receive your tickets directly to your email, either in the form of mobile tickets or a voucher you can exchange on-site for a physical ticket. Your CityPass will activate once you use it at the first attraction from your bundle, making it a fairly seamless experience.
Take up to 51% off iconic experiences in New York City

Ah, the Big Apple. With its iconic buildings, excellent shopping, and decadent dining, there’s no shortage of things to do in the city that never sleeps. Fall and winter are particularly lovely times to visit, what with all of the fall foliage and holiday decorations sprinkled throughout the city. I’ve lived here since 2018, and there are still so many tourist attractions that I haven’t been to. Luckily for me (and anyone who is planning on visiting), it’s easy to book tickets to top attractions in the city and save up to 51% with CityPass.

There are 10 attractions to pick from, and those who bundle five at a time can expect savings of up to 51%, while travelers who plan to stick around for a while can bundle tickets for 11 destinations and save up to 43% (coming out to just $259 per adult for hours and hours of activities). I’ve personally never been to the Empire State Building Observatory or the Statue of Liberty grounds and Ellis Island, so those are the ones that immediately caught my eye. There are also a variety of museums to choose from alongside a couple of viewing platforms—and even a sightseeing cruise amongst the available attractions.
Get savings of up to 49% this fall on Los Angeles attractions through CityPass

Headed to the City of Angels? Me too! I’m eyeing the deals in Los Angeles for a trip I plan to take in the fall, which will let me save up to 49% on tickets when I book a Warner Bros. Studio Hollywood Tour alongside three additional attractions, like a SoFi stadium tour (perfect for those excited about the FIFA World Cup), the Natural History Museum, and the Los Angeles Zoo and Botanical Gardens. Interested in something different? There are also deals for those who dream of seeing movie and TV sets at Universal Studios Hollywood, or for travelers who plan to stay awhile and want to go to both. The savings can really add up—for example, a child's CityPass offers a discount of up to $135 with no need for a promo code.
Score deals of up to 47% off must-see sites in Seattle

If you’re making your way to Seattle for the first time, there are a few attractions that should be at the top of your list, like the Space Needle, the Sky View Observatory, and the Aquarium. Bundle three attractions and save up to 30% off tickets, or for those who really want to take it all in, bundle five attractions and save up to 47% (that's $125 in savings for adult tickets, no promo code needed). In between nature walks, Starbucks trips, and iconic photoshoots by the waterfront, CityPass users can pick between 10 of Seattle’s top attractions to score big while taking in all of Seattle’s unique culture. Whether you’re a solo traveler or a family of five, this is one of the best ways to enjoy the city while sticking to a budget.
Enjoy activities in Denver for up to 43% off through CityPass

The mountains are calling, and who are we to deny them? This year, visit Denver and expect to save up to 43% off top attractions with CityPass. Animal lovers can head to the Downtown Aquarium or the Denver Zoo, while families will love the Botanic Gardens and the Children’s Museum. With eight attractions to choose from, there’s no need to stress over planning the perfect Denver weekend getaway. Guests can bundle three tickets for $54, four for $68, or five for $76.
